note: Nifty 50 closed the week at 25,247.25, +0.16% on the week, in a 329.25-point range. Levels for next week are arithmetic on that range, not a forecast.

cautions.not_a_forecast: Weekly levels are the standard pivot arithmetic on last week's high, low and close. They mark where price has traded, not where it will go. No level here is a buy or sell instruction.
cautions.yahoo_source: Daily index bars come from Yahoo, which is an unofficial endpoint. The nightly NSE bhavcopy does not carry index history, so this is the only free source for it here.
cautions.partial_week: If the newest week has fewer than five sessions the numbers describe a part-week and change as it fills in.
cautions.history_depth: About ten years of daily bars where Yahoo has them. A 52-week high or low is computed from the last 252 sessions.
